pageData.heading: Financial hardship
pageData.para: At Digital DSA, we understand that unexpected circumstances can create challenges in managing your finances. We're here to help you explore alternative options to ease your financial burden.

getHelp.heading: When to Get Help
getHelp.para: If you're worried about missing a payment or struggling to manage your ongoing repayments, reach out to us as soon as possible. Early communication can help reduce stress, and we can work together to find the right solutions for your situation.

cards.heading: Reach out for support early
cards.para:
Unexpected increases in daily expenses, such as cost-of-living pressures, may require you to adjust your budget.

If you're struggling with EMI payments or concerned about managing running loan, don’t wait—reach out to us as soon as possible.

cards.heading: Why you may need financial support
cards.para:
There are many situations where you might find it difficult to keep up with your loan repayments, such as:

  • Cost of living pressures
  • Unemployment or changes in income
  • Death of an earning member
  • (e.g. flood, fire, earthquake)
  • (e.g. divorce, domestic violence)
  • Unexpected expenses or loss in business

cards.heading: Missed or late payments?
cards.para:
If you’re worried that you’ll miss an EMI or will be unable to meet your ongoing EMIs, please contact us.

Even if the issue is short-term, contacting us early allows us to explore solutions together and help you:

  • Avoid late payments fees or penalties.
  • Protect your credit score in CIBIL.

hardshipArrangement.heading: What is a financial hardship arrangement?

cardData.title: What is a financial hardship arrangement?
cardData.para:
If you’re finding it difficult to keep up with repayments (loan EMIs, credit card bills), a "financial hardship arrangement" can offer support during challenging times

We can work with you to create an alternative payment plan, such as:

  • Temporarily deferring your repayments.
  • Allowing reduced payments for a set period.

This arrangement can help prevent you from falling too far behind on your credit card or loan repayments.

You can also checkout our Flexible EMI Planner for better understanding and planning.

cardData.title: Can a hardship arrangement impact your credit score?
cardData.para:
When a borrower enters into a financial hardship arrangement or avails of loan restructuring, it can have an impact on their CIBIL score (or credit score in general), although the extent of the impact depends on the nature of the arrangement and how it's reported.

Entering into an arrangement is recommended as it demonstrates your commitment to getting back on track. If you cannot make your repayments and do not enter an arrangement, it may negatively impact your credit score.

Here's how different types of financial support arrangements may affect your CIBIL score

youKnowlists.heading: Information Accuracy & Subject to Change
youKnowlists.para: While we strive to provide accurate and up-to-date details, financial hardship solutions, eligibility criteria, and lender policies may change over time. The information provided should not be considered final or absolute, and we encourage you to verify details with our support team or financial institutions.

youKnowlists.heading: Impact on Credit Score & Financial History
youKnowlists.para: Engaging in a financial hardship arrangement (such as loan restructuring or EMI deferrals) may impact your CIBIL score or overall credit profile. While such arrangements may help in the short term, they could also affect your future loan eligibility and borrowing capacity. We recommend consulting a financial advisor or credit bureau before making a decision.

youKnowlists.heading: No Guarantee of Approval
youKnowlists.para: Digital DSA provides assistance and guidance, but we do not guarantee approval for hardship relief, loan restructuring, or any other financial modifications. Approval is subject to lender discretion, financial assessment, and relevant eligibility criteria.

youKnowlists.heading: Personal Responsibility & Decision-Making
youKnowlists.para: Financial decisions should be made after careful evaluation of your situation. The information provided here is for general informational purposes only and should not replace professional financial, legal, or tax advice. Always consider seeking independent advice before proceeding with any financial commitments.

youKnowlists.heading: Liability Limitation & Risk Acknowledgment
youKnowlists.para: Digital DSA is not responsible for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential losses, damages, or financial impacts resulting from the use of this information or any decisions made based on it. The responsibility for financial actions lies solely with the user.

youKnowlists.heading: Alternative Financial Support May Be Available
youKnowlists.para: In some cases, additional financial aid options such as government assistance programs, debt consolidation, or refinancing solutions may be more suitable. It is advisable to explore all available options before committing to a hardship arrangement.

youKnowlists.heading: Third-Party Involvement & Lender Policies
youKnowlists.para: Digital DSA acts as a facilitator for financial solutions but does not control lender policies, approval decisions, or repayment terms. Each lender may have different criteria and procedures for handling financial hardship cases.

youKnowlists.heading: Confidentiality & Data Usage
youKnowlists.para: Any personal or financial information shared with Digital DSA is handled with strict confidentiality and used only for the purpose of assessing and assisting with financial hardship requests. However, we recommend reviewing our privacy policy for details on data handling and third-party interactions.
